Item: 73611S17

Description:

A tailored approach to enduring comfort and versatility. The Calden sectional unites a sculptural silhouette with soft oyster white boucle to create the essence of quiet sophistication. It elevates your space while creating a genuinely inviting centerpiece for your home.

  • Includes 5 modular pieces: left-arm corner chair, 2 armless chairs, wedge and right-arm corner chair.
  • “Left‑arm” and “right‑arm” refer to the arm position as you face the piece.
  • Fully finished sides allow each piece to float anywhere in the room.
  • Reversible cushions are easy to remove, fluff and refresh.
  • Coordinating feather fiber blend pillows add soft, inviting comfort.
  • Ultra-thick foam provides supportive, sink-in comfort.
  • Upholstery treated with NuvaLuxe™ adds water‑resistant performance.
  • Non-skid legs reduce movement for added stability.
  • Estimated Assembly Time: 15 Minutes

Fabric Details

  • Body: Polyester (100)%
  • Body and Toss Pillows: Polyester (100)%
  • Standard Shipping: 30 days to return, unused condition required, return fees may apply
  • White Glove/Doorstep Delivery: Report damage within 3 business days - non-damaged items cannot be returned
  • Cannot Return: Final Sale, Clearance, Special Orders, Personalized items, or Mattresses
  • Refunds: 7-10 days to your original payment method (shipping fees non-refundable)
